name: currency-input
title: Currency Input
description: Money field that formats as you type (Rp 12.500.000), keeps the caret in place, and posts the plain number. Optional quick amount chips.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text, linked to the field through for and id.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint below the field. Hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Turns on aria-invalid and the danger border.

props.name: currency
props.description: IDR shows Rp with dot thousands and no decimals. USD shows $ with comma thousands and up to two decimals.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value. The amount is clamped on blur and when a chip is picked.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value. The amount is clamped on blur and when a chip is picked.

props.name: value / defaultValue / v-model
props.description: Starting amount. Blade uses value, React uses defaultValue with onValueChange, Vue uses v-model.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of a hidden input that submits the plain number, for example 12500000. The visible field has no name.

props.name: presets
props.description: Quick amount chips shown below the field, labelled short (50rb, 1jt, $1K). Picking one counts the digits to the new amount.

props.name: presetsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chip group.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the visible field. Generated automatically when empty.

props.name: bind:value / [(value)]
props.description: Svelte and Angular. Two-way binding of the amount. Svelte also takes onValueChange; Angular emits valueChange.

props.name: markas-change
props.description: Astro only. Bubbling event with the new amount as detail.

a11y: The label is linked to the field, and the currency symbol, hint, and error are read through aria-describedby.
The field uses inputmode numeric or decimal so phones show a number keypad.
Chips are toggle buttons in a labelled group; the chip that matches the amount has aria-pressed true.
With reduced motion picking a chip sets the amount instantly instead of counting.

ai.whenToUse: Entering an amount of money: top-ups, transfers, prices, budgets, donations. Default to IDR for Indonesian products.
rules: Read the plain number from the hidden input (name) or onValueChange, never parse the visible text
Always set a label, and put limits in hint, for example Minimum Rp10.000
Keep presets to 3 to 6 common amounts
Validate min and max on the server as well

id.description: Kolom uang yang memformat saat mengetik (Rp 12.500.000), menjaga posisi kursor, dan mengirim angka murni. Opsional chip nominal cepat.

props.label: Teks label, terhubung ke kolom lewat for dan id.
props.hint: Petunjuk di bawah kolom. Disembunyikan saat error tampil.
props.error: Pesan error. Menyalakan aria-invalid dan border danger.
props.currency: IDR menampilkan Rp dengan pemisah ribuan titik tanpa desimal. USD menampilkan $ dengan pemisah ribuan koma dan maksimal dua desimal.
props.min: Nilai terendah. Nominal dibatasi saat blur dan saat chip dipilih.
props.max: Nilai tertinggi. Nominal dibatasi saat blur dan saat chip dipilih.
props.value / defaultValue / v-model: Nominal awal. Blade memakai value, React memakai defaultValue dengan onValueChange, Vue memakai v-model.
props.name: Nama input tersembunyi yang mengirim angka murni, misalnya 12500000. Kolom yang terlihat tidak punya name.
props.presets: Chip nominal cepat di bawah kolom, berlabel singkat (50rb, 1jt, $1K). Memilih chip menghitung angka menuju nominal baru.
props.id: Id kolom yang terlihat. Dibuat otomatis bila kosong.
props.bind:value / [(value)]: Svelte dan Angular. Binding dua arah untuk nominal. Svelte juga menerima onValueChange; Angular memancarkan valueChange.
props.markas-change: Khusus Astro. Event menggelembung dengan nominal baru sebagai detail.

a11y: Label terhubung ke kolom, dan simbol mata uang, petunjuk, serta error dibacakan lewat aria-describedby.
Kolom memakai inputmode numeric atau decimal sehingga ponsel menampilkan keypad angka.
Chip adalah tombol toggle dalam grup berlabel; chip yang cocok dengan nominal punya aria-pressed true.
Saat reduced motion memilih chip langsung mengisi nominal tanpa animasi hitung.

ai.whenToUse: Mengisi nominal uang: top-up, transfer, harga, anggaran, donasi. Pakai IDR sebagai default untuk produk Indonesia.
rules: Ambil angka murni dari input tersembunyi (name) atau onValueChange, jangan mengurai teks yang terlihat
Selalu isi label, dan tulis batas di hint, misalnya Minimum Rp10.000
Batasi presets 3 sampai 6 nominal yang umum
Validasi min dan max juga di server
